company_name: Nippon Light Metal Holdings Company, Ltd.

equity_bridge.item: Investment securities at fair value less deferred tax on AFS gains
equity_bridge.note: FY2026 annual (31-Mar-2026) balance sheet 'Investment securities' 40,705 (cross-shareholdings and equity-method affiliates, carried at fair value); AOCI AFS valuation difference 7,041 net of tax implies ~3.1bn deferred tax on the unrealised gain. Added under the matching-asset rule: dividend and equity-method income sit below operating profit and are therefore NOT in the EBITDA-built flows. FY2026 sold 4.75bn of securities for a 3.15bn gain, so the portfolio is being monetised.
Q1 FY2027 balance sheet, 30-Jun-2026. Charged once here; flows are consolidated.

equity_bridge.item: Net unfunded retirement benefit obligation after tax
equity_bridge.note: FY2026 annual: retirement benefit liability 13,918 less retirement benefit asset 4,483 = 9,435 net deficit, x (1 - 0.306) = 6,550. Debt-like claim on the equity; service cost is already inside operating profit.

historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: EPS CAGRs (29.6% 3yr, 36.0% 5yr) diverge far more than 30% from equity (5.5-6.6%) and revenue (4.2-6.2%) because the start years are cycle troughs (FY2021 EPS 54.37 and FY2023 EPS 116.33 vs FY2026 253.24); they describe the cycle, not a growth trend. Equity CAGR is the only series close to a structural rate and is itself flattered by FX translation and AFS gains. The base-case path does not use any of these as a growth rate: year 1 is the FY2027 guidance (+17.9%, metal-price driven) and years 2-10 mean-revert to 1.5-2.0% nominal.
historical_growth.notes: Owner FCF = reported FCF (SBC 0, interest income not deducted because the company is a net debtor). FCF 3-yr CAGR is undefined (FY2023 owner FCF -17,713 on working-capital build); 5-yr is -24.9% (FY2021 15,258 -> FY2026 3,650) and says nothing about the business beyond the fact that metal-price inflation turns profit into inventory and receivables. FY2019-26 owner FCF: 11.0, 18.9, 15.3, -19.4, -17.7, 14.1, -9.6, 3.7bn; 8-year mean 2.0bn against mean EBITDA ~41bn, which is why the DCF is built from components with an explicit working-capital drag rather than from the FCF line.

scenario_narratives.base: NLM delivers the raised FY2027 guidance (sales 690bn, OP 33bn) on secondary-alloy, chemicals and truck-body strength plus ingot pass-through, then revenue drifts back ~2% in FY2028 as metal prices normalise while the Kobe Steel extrusion JV consolidates from April 2027. The EBITDA margin settles at the 8.0% mid-cycle level the Group has averaged since FY2019: no credit is given for the 26MTP's ROIC 8%+ target beyond that, because the 2022 Toyo Aluminium/UACJ Foil plan was never completed as structured and extrusion has been loss-making for years. Working capital stays the swing factor: 35% of revenue is tied up in receivables and inventory, so every yen of metal-price-driven revenue growth costs ~20 sen of cash, and the owner-FCF yield is structurally below the P/E suggests. Terminal at 12x FCF (~4.3x EBITDA).
scenario_narratives.bull: The 26MTP works: the Kobe JV closes on schedule, consolidates ~58kt/yr of extrusion capacity and turns the segment profitable; sales-price revisions and processing-fee increases stick through the ingot cycle; semiconductor-equipment plate and clean-room panel demand recovers from FY2028; India recycled aluminium scales. Margins return to the FY2019-21 band (9.3-10.0%), ROIC reaches 8%+ by FY2029, the ~40% payout plus securities monetisation keeps the count flat-to-falling. Terminal at the uniform 12x FCF cap and 1.5% growth.
scenario_narratives.bear: Japanese auto production falls a third year under US trade policy, ingot prices reverse ahead of the next price revision (a replay of FY2023, when the EBITDA margin hit 5.3% and OCF went to 0.7bn), the JFTC blocks or delays the Kobe JV, and semiconductor-equipment demand stays weak. Revenue retraces 10% in FY2028 and the margin recovers only to 7.0%; a new quality finding at any plant would re-open the JIS compliance overhang. With 136bn of net debt and 20bn of NCI ahead of equity, the bear value is dominated by the bridge rather than the flows. Terminal at the uniform 12x FCF cap and 0.5% growth; the bear equity value is close to zero because 136bn of net debt and 20bn of NCI absorb nearly the whole enterprise value of a 7%-margin business, which is the leverage finding this scenario exists to show.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Value a vertically integrated aluminium processor on mid-cycle owner FCF, not on a cycle-high guided profit. The FY2027 guidance is taken at face value for year 1 but the record profit is metal-price-inflated revenue at an ordinary margin, so the terminal year is anchored on the 8.0% EBITDA margin the Group has averaged since FY2019 and on a 12x FCF terminal cap in line with where the stock has historically traded. Working capital is modelled explicitly as a drag on revenue growth because 35% of revenue sits in receivables and inventory and owner FCF has averaged ~2bn/yr over eight years against ~41bn of EBITDA. Net debt, NCI and the unfunded pension are deducted; investment securities are added at after-tax fair value because their income is outside the operating flows. Risk is charged once, through 25/50/25 scenario weights at a uniform 8.5% JPY WACC.
key_risks_to_valuation: Working-capital capture (-20% of revenue change) is the single most consequential driver; FY2022-25 history supports -30% to -80% in metal-inflation years, so a sustained ingot up-cycle is worse for owner FCF than the model shows, and a down-cycle releases more cash than it shows.
Terminal margin 8.0% vs the 26MTP's implied ~9%+: each 1pp of terminal EBITDA margin is roughly ¥5bn of terminal FCF, ~¥60bn of terminal EV at 12x, ~¥430/share after discounting.
The Kobe Steel extrusion JV will add consolidated revenue and NCI from FY2028; the definitive agreement (targeted Nov-2026) and JFTC outcome will move the year-2 growth and the NCI bridge item.

Investment securities (37.6bn after tax, ~¥610/share) are a quarter of the price; cross-shareholdings are being sold down (4.75bn in FY2026) which is value-realising but also removes the matching income that was never in the flows.
JPY WACC 8.5% is a judgment above the mechanical CAPM/WACC (~4.5%); each 1pp of WACC is worth roughly ¥250-300/share.
A new quality/inspection finding after the March-2026 remediation close-out would re-rate the name down regardless of the cycle.

data_sources.price: Yahoo Finance chart API at inputs.price_as_of (TSE regular close); 52-week range 2,090-3,330.
data_sources.financials: 5703.T_Metrics.csv / core_metrics (Kessan Tanshin FY2016-FY2026 annuals, half-years and quarters through Q1 FY2027); FY2026 annual tanshin for investment securities, retirement benefit asset/liability, share-count and dilution notes; Q1 FY2027 tanshin (30-Jun-2026) for borrowings, cash, NCI and issued/treasury shares.
data_sources.qualitative: 5703.T_Analysis.json (26MTP targets, Kobe Steel extrusion JV, FY2027 guidance raise of 3-Aug-2026, quality-remediation close-out, segment commentary).

inputs.sbc_source: J-GAAP filer; no share-based payment line in the FY2026 consolidated cash-flow statement. The only equity compensation is a director stock-delivery trust (~330k shares, 0.5% of the count); it is charged ONCE, through the share count (trust shares treated as outstanding), not as an SBC expense. SBC rows kept explicit at 0%.
inputs.share_count_basis: 61,993,750 issued (Q1 FY2027 tanshin, 30-Jun-2026) less ~62k treasury shares outside the stock-delivery trust = 61.93m; the ~330k trust shares will be delivered to directors and are counted as outstanding. FY2026 annual note: 'diluted EPS not presented since there are no dilutive shares'. Held FLAT: no SBC expense in the flows, no non-SBC issuance planned; FY2027 capital policy is a ~40% total payout (dividend + treasury purchases), which supports a flat-to-falling count.
inputs.net_debt_basis: Q1 FY2027 balance sheet at 30-Jun-2026: short-term borrowings 62,697 (incl. current portion of LT) + bonds payable 974 + long-term borrowings 110,691 = 174,362 total debt; cash and deposits 38,496; net debt 135,866. J-GAAP: no lease liabilities on the balance sheet (operating leases expensed; finance-lease obligations immaterial inside 'Other'), so no lease item in net debt.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Built in JPY, the currency of the flows. 10-year JGB ~1.7% (Oct-2026), Japan ERP ~5.5-6.0%, levered beta ~1.1-1.2 for a commodity-exposed processor with D/E ~0.7x -> cost of equity ~8.5%. Pre-tax cost of debt ~1.3% (FY2026 interest paid 2,253 on ~170bn average borrowings), ~0.9% after tax. At market weights (E ~160bn / D ~174bn) the mechanical WACC is ~4.5%, which would price a 4-5% operating-margin aluminium processor as a utility; the house reference for JPY cyclical industrials is ~9%. Adopt 8.5%, applied UNIFORMLY across scenarios: cyclicality, pass-through lag and JV execution risk are charged once, in the probability-weighted flows, not again in per-scenario discount rates.
inputs.lease_treatment: None required: J-GAAP filer, operating leases are expensed inside operating profit (and therefore inside the EBITDA margin path); no lease liabilities are deducted in net debt and no lease principal is deducted from the flows. One treatment, consistently.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are consolidated (EBITDA = consolidated operating profit + D&A), so non-controlling interests are deducted ONCE, in the equity bridge, at the 30-Jun-2026 book value of 19,687 (NCI profit share ~1-1.5bn/yr; Q1 FY2027 1,015). Not folded into the tax/leakage rate.
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF (operating company, non-US cyclical row of the dcf-methods routing table), with the owner-fcf-adaptations applied: JPY-built WACC, J-GAAP lease treatment (none), NCI in the bridge, matching-asset rule (investment securities added because dividend and equity-method income are outside the operating flows), SBC-zero market (house = street, band_position null). FRESH BUILD: first valuation of this ticker, no prior Drivers or DCF. FY LABELS: the CSV's FY2026 is the year ended 31-Mar-2026 (repo end-year convention); FY0 = FY2026, Y1 = FY2027 (ending 31-Mar-2027), guided Aug-2026. CYCLE POSITION: FY2027 guidance (sales 690bn, OP 33bn, ordinary 31bn, NP 17bn, raised 3-Aug-2026 after Q1 OP +103%) is a cycle-high ordinary profit (FY2016-26 range 8.9-31.1bn, mean ~23bn), but the guided EBITDA margin (~7.9%) is AT the FY2019-26 average (8.2%), not above it: the record profit comes from metal-price-inflated revenue (+17.9%), not from margin expansion. The base case therefore takes the guided year 1, then mean-reverts revenue (-2% in FY2028 as ingot prices normalise, partly offset by consolidation of the Kobe Steel extrusion JV from Apr-2027) and holds the terminal margin at 8.0% mid-cycle. The terminal cap is 12x FCF (~4.3x EBITDA), inside the stock's own historical trading range; Gordon at 1.0%/8.5% would be 13.5x so the cap binds in the base. WORKING CAPITAL: receivables + inventory - payables = 204.8bn at 30-Jun-2026 (35% of FY2026 revenue). Metal-price inflation years consumed 30-80% of the revenue increase in cash (FY2022-23 OCF collapsed to 1.5bn / 0.7bn; FY2025 OCF 12.1bn vs ~33bn pre-WC); capture is negative (-20% base, -25% bear, -15% bull), releasing cash when revenue falls. CASH TAX: Japan statutory effective ~30.6%; FY2025-26 cash taxes ran ~25% of pre-tax on subsidiary loss carryforwards; 30.6% is used throughout (conservative). CAPEX: FY2024-26 ran 3.75-4.6% of revenue (22-24bn) against D&A 3.6-3.9%; 3.6% is held (capex slightly above D&A for India recycling, decarbonisation and 26MTP investment). PRICE: TSE regular close, not after-hours; 52-week range 2,090-3,330 so the stock has re-rated ~25% in a year on the guidance raise.

bear.rationale: H2 FY2027 misses as US tariffs cut Japanese auto output further and ingot prices reverse before the next price revision (FY2023 replay: margin 5.3%); Kobe JV blocked or delayed by the JFTC; semiconductor-equipment demand stays sluggish. Margin recovers only to 7.0% (FY2024-26 level) as the structurally oversupplied extrusion business is not fixed. Higher D&A/capex intensity on a smaller revenue base.

base.growth_rationale: Y1 = FY2027 guidance 690bn (+17.85%), maintained in Aug-2026 with Q1 +21.3%; mostly aluminium-ingot pass-through plus secondary-alloy and chemicals volume. Y2 -2%: ingot-price normalisation (-5%) partly offset by consolidation of the Kobe Steel extrusion JV from Apr-2027 (+3%, NLM majority). Y3-10 1.5-2.0% nominal, Japan-weighted mature industrial.
base.margin_rationale: Y1 7.9% ties to guided OP 33bn + D&A ~21.5bn on 690bn; Y2 7.4% as pass-through lags the price reversal; mid-cycle 8.0% from Y5 (FY2019-26 mean 8.2%). Gives no credit for the 26MTP ROIC 8%+ target beyond holding the mid-cycle margin, given the Group's record of delayed restructuring.

bull.rationale: 26MTP delivered: Kobe JV closes Apr-2027 and takes extrusion to a profit, sales-price revisions hold through ingot normalisation, semiconductor-equipment demand recovers from FY2028, India recycling scales. Margins return to the FY2019-21 9.3-10.0% band; ROIC 8%+ reached by FY2029. Working-capital intensity eases with the ~40% payout discipline and portfolio monetisation.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 12x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised from the 15% default to 25%: commodity pass-through lag, two-year auto-volume decline with tariffs explicitly flagged by management, 136bn net debt against ~25bn mid-cycle operating profit, and a restructuring record of slipped plans. Bull cut from 35% to 25%: it needs several independent things to go right (JFTC clearance and JV execution, semiconductor-equipment recovery, margin targets a company with 5-6% ROE history has never sustained). Base 50%.
probability_weighted.band_note: House and street coincide (SBC immaterial): the band collapsed, so band_position is null rather than a degenerate 0.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
